REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.I.D. REGISTRY No I.O. 9369. Central Police Station Date .........）
Date March 1st, 1929

New Soviet Employee.

Made by D.S. Ovs iannikoff Forwarded by H. Gweis A.B. Vol

Sir,
The undermentioned person was engaged by the local
office of the Chinese Eastern Railway since January 1st 1929
for a special ciphering work.
Mrs. A.G. Volchek. Wife of a local Russian Communist
employed in the Dalbank.
Resides at 69 Rue Mayen.

V. Ovs iannikoff
D. S.

a/D. J. I.

（批：A/C. 1/4）

（批：Rev）

Ref. No. d/1.3.29.
Copy forwarded to H.B.M. Consul
Lt Col G.R. Holland for information.
Capt. J.P. Shelley ✓
Lieut E.F. Carlson

日期 1929年3月1日

新聘苏联雇员。

由 D.S. Ovs iannikoff 呈报，经 H. Gweis A.B. Vol 转呈

先生，
下述人员自1929年1月1日起受雇于中东铁路本地办事处，从事专门密码工作。
A.G. Volchek 女士。系一名受雇于远东银行（Dalbank）的本地俄国共产党员之妻。
居住于迈恩路（Rue Mayen）69号。

V. Ovs iannikoff
D. S.

a/D. J. I.

（批注：A/C. 1/4）

（批注：Rev）

参考编号 d/1.3.29.
副本已送交英国驻沪总领事
G.R. Holland 中校知悉。
J.P. Shelley 上尉 ✓
E.F. Carlson 中尉

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. C.I.D. No. 9369 Date 21/8/28）

Subject (in full): CENTRAL I. D. Station.
August 21, 1928

REPORT ON Arrival of Soviet Agent.

Made by P. J. S. Mahlaevsky Forwarded by Tho Rubertson, C.D.I.

The undermentioned Soviet Agent arrived
here from Tsingtao on August 10, 1928 by the s.s. "Dairen
Maru".

Mr. G. F. Volchik Communist. Assistant Director
of the Dalbank. Resides at
69 rue Mayen.

B. Mahlaevsky.
P. J. S.

（批：D. J. H. 21/8）
（批：Copies to. H. D. McDonald
Col. Hallam
Lieut. Goldsmith
Lieut. Carlson Memb.
W. E. G. L.）

下述苏联特工于1928年8月10日乘“大连丸”号轮船（s.s. "Dairen Maru"）从青岛抵达此地。

Shanghai Municipal Police

CENTRAL I. B. Station.
July 13 1923

REPORT ON Departure of Soviet Employees.

Made by P.C.S. OVSIANNIKOFF. Forwarded by

The undermentioned Soviet employees left
Shanghai for Tsingtao on July 12, by the s.s. "Hoten
Maru":-

Comrade G.F. Volchek Assistant Manager of the
Far Eastern Bank(Dalbank),
Communist.

Mrs. Vinogradoff Wife of A.L. Vinogradoff,
Employee of the local branch
of the Chinese Eastern
Railway.

yr

V. Ovsiannikoff
P.C.3.
